summary: Final backend regression passed: 5/5 focused tests covering 10 requested endpoints. /api/orders now returns 200 against existing legacy records and applies the new missing-field defaults. Profit-loss and sales each exactly matched MongoDB counts above 10,000 rows; cash-register-closings limit=0 and all basic collection regressions passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Verified OrderResponse compatibility on existing heterogeneous Mongo rows: missing order_number, order_type, subtotal, and total serialize as 0/dine_in/0.0/0.0; missing items is safely omitted by response_model_exclude_none.
Verified the targeted reads use to_list(length=None): /api/orders, sales, profit-loss, weekly-low-profit, and recompute-costs. The two specifically reported 10,000 caps are removed.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily inserted 10,001 TEST_ITER313_* paid orders for tenant default and business date 2026-07-25. Teardown deleted them and asserted zero matching rows remained.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Final release-gate regression is green. The high-volume assertion compared report order counts to direct Mongo count_documents queries, not merely >10K. Public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL was used for every API call.
rca_of_the_issue: The prior /api/orders 500 was caused by strict required OrderResponse fields against legacy documents. Making order_number, order_type, items, subtotal, and total optional/defaulted restored serialization. The report truncation risk was removed by changing the affected Mongo reads from length=10000 to length=None.
